title: Glowing submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water glow around submarine -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='46' ry='24' fill='#0a3a4a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- submarine body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='34' ry='16' fill='#ffb300'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='32' ry='12' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <!-- body highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='22' y='46' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#fff8e1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- porthole window -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='54' r='7' fill='#1de5ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='54' r='5' fill='#c7fdff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#7dffff'/>
  <!-- front dome -->
  <path d='M84 50 Q92 48 91 55 Q90 62 84 60 Z' fill='#ff9800'/>
  <path d='M85 51 Q89 50 88.5 55 Q88 60 84.5 58 Z' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <!-- periscope -->
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='4' height='16' rx='2' fill='#ff8f00'/>
  <rect x='36' y='24' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffca28'/>
  <rect x='37' y='25' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#fff8e1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- propeller hub -->
  <circle cx='10' cy='54' r='4' fill='#ff8f00'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='54' r='2' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <!-- propeller blades -->
  <ellipse cx='6' cy='46' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#ffca28' transform='rotate(-20 6 46)'/>
  <ellipse cx='6' cy='62' rx='3' ry='7' fill='#ffca28' transform='rotate(20 6 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='47' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#ffca28' transform='rotate(25 14 47)'/>
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='61' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#ffca28' transform='rotate(-25 14 61)'/>
  <!-- glow bubbles -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='36' r='3' fill='#7dffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='28' r='2' fill='#c7fdff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#1de5ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- small fish companion -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='74' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ff6f9c'/>
  <path d='M18 74 L13 70 L13 78 Z' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='73' r='1' fill='#1a237e'/>
</svg>
